## Verdict: APPROVE with notes (no finding or checklist FAIL at or above the critical threshold; acceptance criterion 5 unmet at Important)

The prompt section, the search-before-asking rule, the tool description and the two-turn test are correct, but the PR is not ready to merge as the complete issue fix because `docs/external/managing-memory.md` still lacks the content acceptance criterion 5 requires.
Rule applied: rule 6 — findings and checklist FAILs remain below the critical threshold → APPROVE with notes

## Code Review Findings

### 🟠 Important / Major

1. `docs/external/managing-memory.md` is unchanged, so acceptance criterion 5 is unmet. The page does not explain how a note marks a known ambiguity, how a note naming the meaning or a saved question-and-SQL pair stops the question (with an example of each), or that a note reaches the assistant only on a turn whose message the background context retrieves it for. Its "Verifying Memory After an Import" section also says nothing about a golden question getting a clarifying question, the ERROR result when no query ran, comparison against the lookup SQL, or stating the choice in golden questions. (raised by 1/5 agents) <!-- inertness: first-conjunct=held limb-one=held limb-two=not-held; evidence: criterion 5 asks for doc content only, no mechanism under discussion; git grep —no-index of view-head for managing-memory finds only Markdown links, changelog fragments and inventory.json; published external page -->

(raised by 1/5 agents) <!-- inertness: first-conjunct=held limb-one=held limb-two=held; evidence: internal doc sentence, rewording changes no output or branch; no tool or agent-instruction file reads docs/internal/mcp-server/tools.md; internal page not published -->

  agent.py emits ChatInputUpdateComponent placeholders at lines 241 ("Try again..."), 336 and 499 ("Ask a question..."), 1098 ("Ask a follow-up question..."), 1168 ("Continue the task or ask me something else..."), and also 1075 "Try rephrasing or narrowing the question..." on the consecutive-argument-failure stop path (agent.py:1063-1079). The fifth is not in _GENERIC_INPUT_PLACEHOLDERS (_format.py:126-133), so the comment's 'exactly those ... and Try again... on the error path' is incomplete: an argument-failure stop with no TEXT/DATAFRAME would have that placeholder surfaced as the answer by the filter at _format.py:203 instead of '(no answer)'. The four listed placeholders are correctly emitted and are content-free, and the extra one is on an abnormal stop path rather than normal finalization, so the drift is narrow.

  </details>

</details>
